installStep.name: How should the menu be reached?

plugin.name: Inside the game's own menu (recommended)
plugin.description:
Adds a SKSE MENUS row to the game's System menu, next to SAVE, LOAD and SETTINGS. Open the journal, go to System, and pick it - there is no hotkey to remember and no separate window.
The row is added to the menu as it opens rather than by replacing any of the game's files, so it works alongside menu-artwork mods instead of fighting them, and it takes on whatever look your menus already have. Because it wears your own artwork, the appearance settings (theme, font, text size) are not used and are hidden.
Pick this one unless you specifically want a standalone window.

plugin.name: Standalone window on a hotkey
plugin.description:
The framework opens as its own window on its own key (F1 by default), drawn in its own theme with the full set of appearance settings.
Choose this if you want the menu reachable from anywhere rather than through the pause menu, if you prefer it to look distinct from your game's menus, or if you use a launcher such as Risa's All In One Menu that opens installed mod menus from one place - a standalone window is what those launchers expect to find.
